summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Rojan Kafle's portfolio redesign. All backend APIs functional (health check, contact form with validation and honeypot protection, message retrieval). All frontend features working correctly including navigation, work showcase with lightbox, GitHub repo links, contact form with validation and submission, and responsive mobile layout with index sheet. Contact form successfully integrates with backend and persists messages to MongoDB.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns {status: ok, db: connected}
Backend: POST /api/contact with valid data returns 200 with id and created_at
Backend: POST /api/contact with invalid email returns 422 validation error
Backend: POST /api/contact with honeypot field filled returns 200 but does NOT store in DB (verified)
Backend: GET /api/contact returns list of messages sorted newest-first
Frontend: Home page loads with hero showing 'ROJAN KAFLE' and role line
Frontend: All 6 top nav inline links present and functional (about, work, lab, skills, education, contact)
Frontend: Smooth scroll navigation works on desktop
Frontend: All 4 work cards displayed (summit, the-rocks, aprilia, porsche)
Frontend: Work lightbox opens, displays content, Next/Prev navigation works, Close button works
Frontend: All 4 GitHub repo links present with correct hrefs to github.com/Rojan248/*
Frontend: GitHub profile link present with correct href
Frontend: Contact email link (mailto:), phone link (tel:), GitHub link all present with correct hrefs
Frontend: Contact form validation works (empty name error, invalid email error)
Frontend: Contact form valid submission shows success message, displays sonner toast, and clears form
Frontend: Contact form submission persisted to backend MongoDB (verified via GET /api/contact)
Frontend: Mobile index sheet opens via nav-index-open-button
Frontend: All 7 TOC links present in mobile index sheet (cover, about, work, lab, skills, education, contact)
Frontend: Mobile index sheet closes when TOC link clicked
Frontend: Responsive layout works at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) without horizontal overflow
